recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate close-up portrait of a man with 1970s-style hair and mustache, framed within a cream-colored border. The subject's eyes are the focal point, looking directly at the viewer over a crossed arm. The background features a soft, painterly wash of pastel colors, and the typography is a classic, high-contrast serif centered at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eyes aligned with the horizontal midline of the inner frame
Tight cropping of the head against a wide cream border
Contrast between the detailed texture of the hair/mustache and the soft-focus background
Typography centered in the top margin, bridging the border and the image
coreInvariants: Cream-colored outer border framing the central square image
Direct eye contact with a neutral, soulful expression
Soft, diffused lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head filling approximately 70% of the inner frame, positioned centrally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the mustache and crossed arm, then upward to the centered title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial cream-colored border acts as a breathing room around the dense central portrait.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the hair and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted teal and denim blue in the clothing and background accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel yellows and pinks in the hazy background wash.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a warm, slightly yellowed vintage cast.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use deep browns for shadows

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
Ball terminals on lowercase letters like 'a' and 'y'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing (tracking) typical of 70s phototypesetting

composition.overlap: Slightly overlaps the top edge of the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title, separated by a vertical bar or slash.
graphicDevices: Square inner frame with rounded or sharp corners

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight, high-contrast 70s serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the classic, readable serif structure with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up 1970s style portrait of a man with long brown hair and a mustache, looking directly at the camera. He is leaning on his arm. The background is a soft, out-of-focus pastel wash of blue, yellow, and pink. The entire image is framed by a wide, solid cream-colored border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered serif text in the top margin. Use a high-contrast serif font like Caslon, set in title case with tight tracking. The text should be a dark muted brown and sit partially on the cream border and partially on the image.

verificationChecks: Is the eye contact direct and central?
Does the cream border have a consistent width?
Is the typography high-contrast and tightly spaced?
Is the color palette warm and vintage-toned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pastel background wash
mustRedesign: Remove specific record label logos in the corners
Change the specific names and titles to generic placeholders
Ensure the hair style is generic 70s rather than a specific celebrity likeness

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and soft focus

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct serif anatomy (high contrast)
Ensure the cream border is not pure white
Verify the subject's gaze is level and engaging
Confirm the background colors are soft and blended
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a tight, soulful 70s portrait with a wide cream border and centered, high-contrast serif typography for a classic singer-songwriter aesthetic.
